items.title: Family stranded at sea for 16 hours after jet ski capsized in Thailand
items.dek: A father and his two young sons spent a night adrift before being rescued off the coast of the island of Koh Samui.

items.title: Moment family rescued after 16 hours floating on jet ski off Thailand
items.dek: A 50-year-old father and his two sons were found floating off Koh Samui island, a local official told AFP on Saturday.
